name: node_similarity
author: ab9fb3a3
description: Compares two nodes using common neighbours and Jaccard similarity (intersection size divided by union size). Use for similar friend circles or overlapping airport connections. Supports undirected or directed graphs; direction selects incoming, outgoing, or combined neighbours. Ignores weights and self-loops. Returns labelled input nodes, exact counts, a six-decimal jaccard_score, and up to top_k common neighbours. Two empty neighbour sets score zero.

graph_id.description: ID of a graph registered in the provided store.

node_a.description: First exact node ID; use lookup_node to resolve names.

node_b.description: Second exact node ID; may equal node_a.

direction.description: Neighbour sets: all ignores edge direction, in uses incoming, out uses outgoing. Equivalent on undirected graphs.

top_k.description: Maximum entries in each returned node list; calculations still use the full graph.
